Version: all versions of Polkit since initial pkexec commit in May 2009
Method of Attack: memory corruption vulnerability in Polkit's pkexec component allowing any unprivileged user to gain full root privileges on a vulnerable system using default polkit configuration
Attack Vector: local attacker exploiting pkexec program on default installations
Indicators of Compromise: logs containing 'The value for the SHELL variable was not found the /etc/shells file'
logs containing 'The value for environment variable […] contains suspicious content.'
